The '''Personal Transport Assembly Shop''' was an assembly shop on [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] during the [[Old Republic era]]. It was known to assemble and paint [[Speeder bike/Legends|Speeder bikes]]. It was once considered by [[Narsk Ka'hane]] to be too toxic even for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s workers to work at.
